0022600103.text: The Portland Trail Blazers (1-0, 2nd in the Northwest and 0.5 games back) visit the Sacramento Kings (0-1, 4th in the Pacific and 1 game back) in Portland's second game of the season. Portland will be without Branden Carlson (concussion), Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (knee dislocated), and Malik Monk is day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Portland won all four matchups in 2025-26, most recently a 122-110 win in Portland on April 12, 2026.
